summary: A private web portal is taking shape for the friend group: a status page and a memory showcase of what Nora has learned about each of you.
details: Status shows her uptime, whether her memory and message store are reachable, and how many reminders are still pending.
The memory showcase shows every whitelisted friend her current read on them, shared with the whole group — not just your own.
Login is Discord OAuth, checked against the same identity.toml roster Nora herself already uses — no separate account to manage.
limitations: Not yet publicly reachable — the docker-compose service, real Discord OAuth app, and Cloudflare Tunnel exposure are still to come.
Game-server status and any presence/map view are designed but not part of this change.
